13922-the-visionary-pictures-from-nordla.title: Pictures From Nordland
13922-the-visionary-pictures-from-nordla.creator: Jonas Lie
13922-the-visionary-pictures-from-nordla.description: A book by Jonas Lie. The fact is, there is a revolution in the streets--not a political revolution, Heaven preserve him from that--but one which has an attraction for him, because it awakens all his old recollections, and in which, much to his disgrace, he contrives surreptitiously to join, although, in its own way, it too defies all police arrangements, breaks windows, puts out street-lamps, tears the tiles from the house-roofs, damages piers and moorings, and chases police and watchmen into their holes.

arxiv-1912-08667.title: Global well-posedness of the two-dimensional stochastic nonlinear wave equation on an unbounded domain
arxiv-1912-08667.creator: Leonardo Tolomeo
arxiv-1912-08667.description: Abstract . We study the two-dimensional wave equation with cubic nonlinearity posed on ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} , with space-time white noise forcing. After a suitable renormalisation of the nonlinearity, we prove global well-posedness for this equation for initial data in ℋ s \mathcal{H}^{s} , s > 4 5 s>\frac{4}{5} . 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 35L71, 60H15 1.

arxiv-2007-05077.title: Coupling-independent, Real-time Wireless Resistive Sensing through Nonlinear 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetry
arxiv-2007-05077.creator: Siavash Kananian, George Alexopoulos, Ada S. Y. Poon
arxiv-2007-05077.description: Abstract We report the realization of coupling-independent, robust wireless sensing of fully-passive resistive sensors. 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric operation obviates sweeping, permitting real-time, single-point sensing. Self-oscillation is achieved through a fast-settling nonlinearity whose voltage amplitude is proportional to the sensor’s resistance. These advances markedly simplify the reader.

arxiv-2205-07071.title: Teleparallel Geometry with a Single Affine Symmetry
arxiv-2205-07071.creator: A. A. Coley, R. J. van den Hoogen
arxiv-2205-07071.description: Abstract In teleparallel geometries, symmetries are represented by affine frame symmetries which constrain both the (co)frame basis and the spin-connection (which are the primary geometric objects). In this paper we shall study teleparallel geometries with a single affine symmetry, utilizing the locally Lorentz covariant approach and adopting a complex null gauge.

arxiv-2301-05137.title: Density functions of periodic sequences of continuous events
arxiv-2301-05137.creator: Olga Anosova, Vitaliy Kurlin
arxiv-2301-05137.description: Abstract Periodic Geometry studies isometry invariants of periodic point sets that are also continuous under perturbations. The motivations come from periodic crystals whose structures are determined in a rigid form but any minimal cells can discontinuously change due to small noise in measurements.

arxiv-2308-04526.title: Large-Scale Multi-Hypotheses Cell Tracking Using Ultrametric Contours Maps
arxiv-2308-04526.creator: Jordão Bragantini, Merlin Lange, Loïc Royer
arxiv-2308-04526.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jordão Bragantini, Merlin Lange, Loïc Royer. In this work, we describe a method for large-scale 3D cell-tracking through a segmentation selection approach. The proposed method is effective at tracking cells across large microscopy datasets on two fronts: (i) It can solve problems containing millions of segmentation instances in terabyte-scale 3D+t datasets; (ii) It achieves competitive results with or without deep learning, bypassing the requirement of 3D annotated data, that is scarce in the fluorescence microscopy field.

arxiv-2404-11479.title: Zeros of generalized hypergeometric polynomials via finite free convolution. Applications to multiple orthogonality
arxiv-2404-11479.creator: Andrei Martínez-Finkelshtein, Rafael Morales, Daniel Perales
arxiv-2404-11479.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrei Martínez-Finkelshtein, Rafael Morales, Daniel Perales. We address the problem of the weak asymptotic behavior of zeros of families of generalized hypergeometric polynomials as their degree tends to infinity. The main tool is the representation of such polynomials as a finite free convolution of simpler elements; this representation is preserved in the asymptotic regime, so we can formally write the limit zero distribution of these polynomials as a free convolution of explicitly computable measures.

arxiv-2407-11285.title: Projective Rectangles: The Graph of Lines Thanks: Flórez’s research was partially supported by a grant from The Citadel Foundation.
arxiv-2407-11285.creator: Rigoberto Flórez, Thomas Zaslavsky
arxiv-2407-11285.description: Abstract . A projective rectangle is like a projective plane that may have different lengths in two directions. We develop properties of the graph of lines, in which adjacency means having a common point, especially its strong regularity and clique structure.

arxiv-2502-02065.description: Abstract I Introduction With the growing demand for electronics, the development cycles for new application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) designs are becoming increasingly shorter. To meet these shorter design cycles, hardware designers apply the principles of reusability and modularity of IP blocks in their designs.

arxiv-2503-16757.title: Measure-expansive systems
arxiv-2503-16757.creator: C. A. Morales
arxiv-2503-16757.description: Abstract . We call a dynamical system on a measurable metric space measure-expansive if the probability of two orbits remain close each other for all time is negligible (i.e. zero). We extend results of expansive systems on compact metric spaces to the measure-expansive context.

pmc-11433290.creator: Antonio Benjamim Mapossa, Erick Gabriel Ribeiro dos Anjos, Uttandaraman Sundararaj, Yuanqing Li
pmc-11433290.description: This study investigates the effects of inorganic flame retardants, zinc borate, and magnesium hydroxide, on the thermal, morphological, flame retardancy, and mechanical properties of polypropylene (PP)/calcium carbonate composites for potential construction industry applications. Polypropylene/calcium carbonate (50 wt.%) composites containing 5 and 10 wt.% flame retardants were prepared using a batch mixer, followed by compression moulding.

pmc-11578388.title: Flu-Phobia: Influenza Vaccine Hesitancy in a Rural Primary Care Setting
pmc-11578388.creator: Samantha M Lavertue, Richard Terry, Rachael Muggleton
pmc-11578388.description: The sentiments expressed by individuals, such as “I do not trust vaccines,” “I do not believe in vaccines,” and “I do not want a shot,” are commonly encountered by physicians during the annual influenza season. This study investigates vaccine hesitancy regarding the influenza vaccine within a rural primary care setting in New York State.

pmc-11603862.title: Exploring the educational journey: perspectives of ethnic minority GP-trainees in Dutch GP-specialty training - a qualitative interview study
pmc-11603862.creator: NM van Moppes, M Nasori, AC Jorissen, JM van Es, J Bont, MRM Visser, METC van den Muijsenbergh
pmc-11603862.description: BackgroundPrevious research highlights persistent differential attainment by ethnicity in medical education, wherein the perceived inclusiveness significantly influences ethnic minority students’ and trainees’ outcomes. Biased organizational practices and microaggressions exacerbate the challenges faced by ethnic minorities, leading to lower academic performance and higher dropout rates.

pmc-12470281.title: Increasing Temperature Activates TREK Potassium Currents in Vagal Afferent Neurons from the Nodose Ganglion
pmc-12470281.creator: Lola Rueda-Ruzafa, Ana Campos-Ríos, Paula Rivas-Ramírez, Manuela Rodríguez-Castañeda, Salvador Herrera-Pérez, José Antonio Lamas, Sheng-Nan Wu, Ari-Pekka Koivisto
pmc-12470281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Temperature homeostasis is controlled by the vagus nerve. Thermal information is collected by thermoreceptors present in the viscera and driven across sensory neurons of the nodose ganglia (NG), which in turn send it to the hypothalamus. While transient receptor potential channels (TRPs) are traditionally considered for thermal transduction, TREK channels belonging to the two-pore domain K+ channels family are emerging as thermosensors, but their role in the NG remains understudied.
